title: BR-Koramangala leased-line congestion
root_cause: Local leased-line carrier congested during morning peak. No fault in branch router itself — upstream carrier issue. ATM transactions slowed from 0.1s to 2.4s.
resolution: Traffic rerouted via backup SD-WAN tunnel to ZO-Bengaluru. Carrier notified. ATM latency restored within 8 minutes.
